text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear opening claim and closing restatement","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"The essay states a position early and returns to it at the end, keeping the response centered on a defensible claim."},{"evidence":"Three body paragraphs with distinct points","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is arranged into separate sections that each develop a different reason, which makes the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"Explains why drivers may become less skilled","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"The essay does more than mention a downside; it explains how relying on automation could weaken driving ability over time."},{"evidence":"Uses rhetorical questions and hypotheticals","quality":"persuasive development","description":"The essay builds its case by posing scenarios about malfunctions, boredom, and lost control that help the argument feel more fully developed."},{"evidence":"Acknowledges positives before rejecting them","quality":"balanced consideration","description":"The essay briefly concedes the benefits of driverless cars and then explains why it still opposes them, which strengthens its argumentative credibility."}]}
